title: CoAgent8 configuration
description: Shared by the coagent8 CLI, its MCP server and every MCP host. In VS Code, CoAgent8 settings set in the user settings take precedence.

$schema.description: Optional schema location for a custom configuration path.

defaultBackend.description: Backend used when a request does not name one. null chooses among routing.allowedBackends by routing.strategy. gemini is Antigravity. VS Code setting: coagent8.defaultBackend.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Automatic: choose among the allowed backends.

routing.description: How automatic requests choose a backend.

strategy.description: fixed always uses the default backend; smart_quota prefers a backend whose quota is not exhausted. VS Code setting: coagent8.routing.strategy.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Prefer a backend whose quota is not exhausted.

allowedBackends.description: Backends CoAgent8 may run. gemini is Antigravity. VS Code setting: coagent8.routing.allowedBackends.

codex.description: Codex CLI. VS Code setting: coagent8.codex.defaultModel.

claude.description: Claude Code CLI. VS Code setting: coagent8.claude.defaultModel.

gemini.description: Antigravity CLI (agy). VS Code setting: coagent8.gemini.defaultModel.

governance.description: When CoAgent8 asks for your approval before a model runs. A calling agent cannot grant it.

priceMultiplier.description: Ask before a model that costs at least this many times the backend's default model. VS Code setting: coagent8.approval.priceMultiplier.

askAbovePrice.description: Ask before a model whose output price is at least this many USD per million tokens; null disables this threshold. VS Code setting: coagent8.approval.askAbovePrice.

alwaysAsk.description: Models that always need your approval before they run, even when also listed in neverAsk. VS Code setting coagent8.approval.alwaysAskModels adds to this list.

neverAsk.description: Models that run without asking, unless also listed in alwaysAsk. An approval with "remember" adds the model here. VS Code setting coagent8.approval.neverAskModels adds to this list.

model.description: Model identifier or CLI alias, for example opus.

defaultModel.description: Model used when a request names none. Recorded by doctor when missing.
